title: People’s Mañanera September 24
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**Plan México Attracts Investment and Jobs  
** LEGO will invest US$400 million in Nuevo León, create 1,300 jobs, and
strengthen domestic suppliers. President Claudia Sheinbaum emphasized that
“this investment demonstrates confidence in our country” and bolsters domestic
production and exports.

**Less Red Tape, Greater Technological Sovereignty  
** More than 4,000 red tape paperwork procedures have been simplified and
1,947 eliminated, reducing requirements and processing times. In addition, 300
Mexican engineers developed public technology that has generated 14 billion
pesos (US$800 million) in savings for the government.

**Digital Economy to Strengthen Small Businesses  
** Under the new law, small shops, street stalls, and small businesses will be
able to accept payments via SPEI and CoDi, commission-free and in seconds,
facilitating their financial inclusion. Cash is not being eliminated, but the
goal is to facilitate commission-free digital payments.

**More Innovation and Protection for Products Made in Mexico  
** The reform modernizes the Mexican Industrial Property Institute (IMPI) to
reduce trademark and patent registration times by 35%, protect industrial and
intellectual property, combat smuggling and illegal copying, and prevent the
commercial use of the Mexican government’s image.

**“People are happy; they’re satisfied”  
** The President reported that life satisfaction among Mexicans aged 12 and
older reached 8.75 out of 10 in 2026. She noted that this sentiment is also
reflected in the closeness and communication she experiences with people
during her travels throughout the country.
